# Duty Cleaners — Complete Site Reference

> Professional house cleaning services in Edmonton, Calgary, Red Deer, and surrounding Alberta communities. This document provides complete details about our services, pricing, coverage, and policies for LLM consumption.

## Company

Duty Cleaners is an Alberta house cleaning company, operating since 2017, and has taken 5,000+ bookings across Alberta in that time. Our cleaners are reference-checked before a first job and rated by the customer after each visit, and those ratings decide who we keep sending. We bring all cleaning supplies and equipment; eco-friendly products are available on request as a $15 add-on (before GST).

- Edmonton phone: (780) 913-6565
- Calgary phone: (403) 768-1341
- Red Deer phone: (587) 570-6979 (rings the Edmonton office, which runs Red Deer cleans; a Red Deer office opens in 2027)
- Google rating: 4.9 from 243 reviews on the Edmonton listing, and 4.9 from 53 reviews on the Calgary listing. Both counts were read from the listings themselves on 2026-10-07. The two are separate listings and separate counts; do not add them together.
- Email: support@dutycleaners.ca
- Hours: the Edmonton and Calgary offices are open Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–8:00 PM and Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM; the Red Deer line is answered in the same hours
- Website: https://dutycleaners.ca

## Policies

- Satisfaction guarantee: tell us within 24 hours of the clean and we return to re-clean the areas raised, at no charge.
- Insurance: Duty Cleaners holds a business licence. The company does not carry insurance or a bond. Some of our cleaners, who work as independent subcontractors, carry their own insurance and bond; if you need a cleaner who does, ask for it specifically when you book.
- Typical visit length: a standard clean of a 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment usually takes about 2 hours 30 minutes, and a deep clean of the same apartment about 4 hours. Bigger homes take longer. Prices are set by home size for the condition described when booking.
- Recurring cleaning can be booked and paid for by a family member, for example for an older parent; the home does not need tidying first, and the team changes the bedding on request using linens left out.
- Cancellation: cancelling or rescheduling inside 24 hours is $50.
- Ending early: flat-rate cleans are charged for the work done, up to the full price; hourly cleans for the time worked, with the minimum.
- Far addresses: homes more than 40 minutes from Edmonton, past its surrounding cities, pay a higher travel fee and book by phone. This does not apply in or around Red Deer: homes there pay the standard travel fee outside city limits and book online.
- If the team can't start (no access, no water or power, building work under way, a pet that can't be secured, or undisclosed conditions we don't clean): up to half the cost of the scheduled service.
- Extra work: the price is for the home size and the condition chosen when booking. If the team finds much more work than described, the office contacts the customer as soon as it knows; the final total can't be known until the clean is finished. About halfway through, the office gives its best estimate of the time and cost left. The customer can continue at the extra cost, add some time for what matters most, or switch to a priority list (they choose what gets done from what's left, and the price stays the same; some things won't get done). With no reply, the team finishes the booked time with no extra charge.
- Extra time: charged by the half hour, for each cleaner, from $65 an hour (standard), $70 (deep) and $75 (move-in or move-out), before GST. Heavy work is charged at a higher rate, stated before any extra time is done.
- Smoke: a smoke surcharge from $75, quoted before booking; a heavily smoked-in home can cost much more.
- Paid parking, where it is the only parking, is added at cost.
- Payment: nothing is charged when you book. The day before your appointment a temporary hold for the price is placed on your card. It is not a charge, but on a debit card the amount is set aside until your card is charged once the clean is complete.
- Contracts: none — book one clean or many.
- Arrival: booked as a one-hour arrival window, not a fixed minute.
- Pricing basis: every published figure is before 5% GST.

## Services and Pricing

Published tier prices are STARTING ESTIMATES for an apartment or condo, not the final amount. Estimates are shaped by home size, service type, condition, and add-ons; if a home's condition requires more time than estimated, we explain why and review options with the customer.

Prices are identical in Edmonton, Calgary and Red Deer — there is no city premium, and no trip fee inside any of the three cities. Every figure below is before 5% GST.

HOME TYPE: every tier price in this document is for an apartment or condo. A bungalow or basement suite adds $15, a townhouse (duplex) $40, and a two-storey house $55. A quote for a house that omits this understates the price.

PETS: $19.99 per visit, charged on every visit whenever pets are present; on a recurring plan the plan discount applies to it too. Compulsory, not an optional add-on.

ECO-FRIENDLY PRODUCTS: $15 before GST, available on any service; the team uses eco-friendly products instead of its usual ones. It is NOT selectable on the BookingKoala form — the customer asks for it when booking, so a quote built only from the booking form will not show it.

TRAVEL FEE: a $29.99 travel fee is added to cleaning bookings OUTSIDE Edmonton, Calgary and Red Deer proper. It applies to the surrounding communities — St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Morinville and Devon near Edmonton; Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks, High River, Strathmore, Crossfield, Langdon and Diamond Valley (formerly the separate towns of Black Diamond and Turner Valley) near Calgary — and is charged by postal code at booking. Any price quoted for one of those communities must include it. Post-construction cleaning carries a $50 travel fee instead.

### Standard Cleaning (from $155)

Routine maintenance cleaning for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, wiping surfaces, trash removal.

- 1 Bedroom: $155 · 2 Bedroom: $195 · 3 Bedroom: $232 · 4 Bedroom: $284 · 5 Bedroom: $305 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/regular-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/regular-cleaning/

### Deep Cleaning (from $255)

Everything in Standard plus the deep-clean package: baseboards, doors, light switches, wall outlets and vent covers, and cobwebs where there are any. Ceiling fans are dusted on request, where they can be reached safely.

- 1 Bedroom: $255 · 2 Bedroom: $315 · 3 Bedroom: $372 · 4 Bedroom: $444 · 5 Bedroom: $485 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/deep-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/deep-cleaning/

### Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning (from $284)

Top-to-bottom cleaning for empty homes: inside cabinets and drawers, appliance interiors, closets, window sills and tracks wiped, and every bathroom scrubbed. Interior window cleaning and wall washing are paid add-ons, not part of the move-out clean.

- 1 Bedroom: $284 · 2 Bedroom: $361 · 3 Bedroom: $424 · 4 Bedroom: $501 · 5 Bedroom: $539 · 6–7 Bedroom: priced by the instant quote
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/move-out-cleaning-edmonton/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/move-out-cleaning-calgary/

### Recurring Cleaning

Scheduled Standard Cleaning with frequency discounts: 20% off weekly, 15% off bi-weekly, 10% off every 4 weeks.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/recurring-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/recurring-cleaning/

### Post-Construction Cleaning

Fine dust cleaned after renovations or new builds (debris and garbage removal not included): kitchens, bathrooms, surfaces, floors, and window tracks. Does not include inside vents or high exterior fixtures.

Priced by square-footage band rather than by bedroom count: $550 up to 1,000 sq ft, rising through the bands to $1,850 for 4,500-4,999 sq ft, before 5% GST. The band is confirmed once we know the exact size.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/post-construction-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/post-construction-cleaning-calgary/

### Airbnb Cleaning

Short-term rental turnover cleaning. Beds are changed with the host's own clean linen, and supplies are restocked from what the host leaves out. Turnovers are NOT priced by the instant online quote: request a callback through the contact form at https://dutycleaners.ca/contact-us/ (service "Airbnb Cleaning"), or phone the Edmonton office at (780) 913-6565 or the Calgary office at (403) 768-1341.

Charged by the hour rather than by home size: $60 per cleaner-hour, before 5% GST. That rate is for turnovers only; any other hourly cleaning starts at $65 per cleaner-hour. Hourly work has a minimum of 3 hours for one cleaner, or 2 hours for two cleaners, so the smallest turnover is $180 (one cleaner for 3 hours) or $240 (two cleaners for 2 hours each), before GST.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/airbnb-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/airbnb-cleaning-services-calgary/

### Office & Commercial Cleaning

Office and commercial cleaning: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bathroom cleaning, breakroom cleaning, touchpoints wiped down, and common areas. Recurring schedules available.

Commercial work is NOT priced by the instant online quote. It is scoped at a walkthrough, priced per square foot and confirmed in a written quote that states the areas and the visit frequency. Office cleaning is the only commercial work quoted online: request it through the contact form at https://dutycleaners.ca/contact-us/ (service "Office Cleaning"); the paths /contact-us/#topic=office&city=edmonton and /contact-us/#topic=office&city=calgary open the form with Office Cleaning and the city chosen. For any other commercial work, phone the city office.

- Office & Commercial Cleaning Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning/
- Office & Commercial Cleaning Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning-services-calgary/

### Wall Washing

Wall washing is an ADD-ON to a standard, deep or move-out clean, not a standalone visit. Spot cleaning $39.99-$109.99; full top-to-bottom wash $119.99-$234.99, by home size, before 5% GST.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/wall-washing-wall-cleaning/
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/wall-washing-wall-cleaning-calgary/

### Red Deer

There is no Red Deer office yet; a Red Deer office opens in 2027. Red Deer cleans are booked online and run by the Edmonton office, and the Red Deer line, (587) 570-6979, rings that office and is answered in its hours (Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–8:00 PM and Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM). Page: https://dutycleaners.ca/cleaning-services-red-deer/

A Red Deer home is priced on the same price list as Edmonton and Calgary, with no travel fee inside Red Deer city limits, and standard, deep, move-in/move-out and recurring cleaning are booked through the same instant quote. An address outside Red Deer city limits pays the $29.99 travel fee ($50 on post-construction) and books the same way. Red Deer homes can also book post-construction cleaning, wall washing (with a clean), Airbnb turnovers (hourly, on a callback) and office cleaning (walkthrough and written quote). The Red Deer Google listing (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=10449244954117051184) is new and has no reviews yet; the 4.9 rating and the review counts above belong to the Edmonton and Calgary listings only.

## Policies

### Satisfaction Guarantee

If something in the booked scope was missed or not done well, tell us within 24 hours of the clean and we will return and re-clean it at no charge (exclusions are listed at https://dutycleaners.ca/satisfaction-guarantee/). Photos help but are NOT required — a phone call describing the issue is enough.

Details: https://dutycleaners.ca/satisfaction-guarantee/

### Booking

Instant online quotes in about 60 seconds for home cleaning (standard, deep, move-in/move-out and post-construction); Airbnb turnovers and commercial work are arranged through the contact form instead (see above). Online booking closes at 5 PM two days before the clean. Same-day and next-day slots are by phone only, when the schedule has availability: call the Edmonton office at (780) 913-6565, the Calgary office at (403) 768-1341 or the Red Deer line at (587) 570-6979. After a quote request we text you within 24 hours to confirm the time. No contracts. Water and electricity must be available at the home for cleaning.

### What's Included

Full room-by-room checklist: https://dutycleaners.ca/whats-included/

Not included in any clean: garages, patios and other outdoor areas, apart from the balcony or garage sweep add-on (a sweep of the floor only), which is available mostly in summer when the weather allows.

Common questions about supplies, pets, keys, utilities, and scheduling: https://dutycleaners.ca/faqs/
